title: Google\Cloud\RecommendationEngine\V1beta1\ImportErrorsConfig
name: ImportErrorsConfig
description: Configuration of destination for Import related errors.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.gcs_prefix
params.description: Google Cloud Storage path for import errors. This must be an empty, existing Cloud Storage bucket. Import errors will be written to a file in this bucket, one per line, as a JSON-encoded google.rpc.Status message.
